common: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: final AQUABIT game pixel sprite, TWO-frame horizontal transparent strip. Make a BRAND NEW sprite in a consistent charming coarse retro aquarium style: bold stepped deep navy #0b1d3a outline, clear readable silhouette, at most 8 solid flat colors, big square pixel clusters, small tasteful 2-tone shading, not realistic, not a vector illustration. Virtual sheet EXACTLY 128x40 pixels, two equally spaced 64x40 cells, each character centered at x=32,y=20 within its cell with 4px transparent margin. Draw on a 32x20 logical grid per cell enlarged 2x. No detail thinner than one logical pixel. Fish face LEFT in both cells. Identical species, body alignment, colors, size and eye location between frames. Left cell resting tail/legs; right cell VERY SUBTLY alternate fins or legs. Do not flip the entire creature in second cell. Strong shape distinction across species. Genuine transparent background, no labels, no letters, no scene, no accessories, no glow, no drop shadow, no gradients, no scale texture or stippling, no stray pixels. Keep all extremities inside their cell. If generating larger dimensions, preserve exact 3.2:1 sheet aspect and enlarge pixels without smoothing. This is an editable sprite, NOT a screenshot.

species.gold: Goldfish: rounded orange plump body, small dorsal fin, broad beautiful forked gold tail, tiny black-and-white eye, warm orange #ff9a35, rich orange shade #de662d and pale golden belly #ffe5a0. Friendly elegant simple silhouette. Second frame fans the tail slightly.
species.guppy: Guppy: slim mint teal body with a disproportionately large red-coral triangular fan tail on right, small dorsal fin, black eye. Body #50cfb4, shade #229c9b, pale mint belly #c8f5de, red coral tail #f47e86. Do not look like goldfish. Second frame flexes fan tail one logical pixel.
species.betta: Betta fish: compact deep blue-violet body with a sweeping large plum-purple tail and broad flowing dorsal and ventral fins, vivid magenta accents. Body #6c78dc, shade #4656a5, tail #b784dc, accent #ed86b7, pale lilac belly #ded7ff. Show flowing fins with only 2-3 large flat patches, no thin fin rays. Second frame gently contracts flowing tail.
species.neon: Neon tetra: slim small silver-blue fish, a continuous brilliant cyan-blue stripe from head toward tail and a distinct scarlet-red LOWER rear stripe, small transparent-looking pale cyan fins, tiny tail. Cyan #45cbe9, deeper blue #277fc1, crimson #ee626d, pale silver #d6eff9. Second frame flicks tail tip.
species.shrimp: Blue velvet shrimp: clearly a SHRIMP, left-facing small blue elongated head with black eye, two clean stepped antennae toward upper-left, arched segmented upper back, cyan belly highlights, small tail fan on right, six SHORT chunky legs underneath. Use blue #248cd4, shade #1563aa, highlight #55d1df, pale #c8f2ee. Maximum 3 segment marks, no speckles. Legs have their lowest pixel edge at y=36 within both 64x40 cells, so it stands on sand. Second frame alternates legs without changing body or baseline.
species.angel: Freshwater angelfish: recognizably tall triangular diamond shaped silver-cyan body, tall pointed dorsal and anal fins, two short thick ventral filaments, tiny tail on right, ONE bold dark blue vertical band behind head. Colors cyan #54c5d4, silver #d2f0ed, blue-gray #347aa1, pale golden accent #ecd18b. Tiny black eye at left. Second frame gently flexes tall fin tips.
species.starfish: A five-armed coral orange STARFISH seen from above, symmetrical organic five-point star, clearly not a fish and no face or eyes. Deep navy stepped outline, warm coral #f18468, orange shadow #d66f58, peach #ffd1a1, a few large simple cream center spots. Rounded chunky tapered arms. Center at (32,20); lowest arm tips end at y=36 in each 64x40 cell so it rests on sand. Second frame slightly bends two arm tips, same center and baseline.
